newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia May crude palm oil output up 7.61 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia May crude palm oil output up 7.61 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's crude palm oil output rose 7.61 percent to 790,640 tonnes in May from 734,694 in April and against 722,888 in May 1996, the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA) said on Monday.
May palm oil exports were 626,606 tonnes against 579,211 in April and 555,682 in May 1996, it said.
PORLA said Peninsular Malaysia's crude palm oil output rose 9.16 percent to 589,202 tonnes in May from 539,711 in April and 550,538 in May 1996.
Output from east Malaysian states of Sabah and Sarawak rose 3.34 percent to 201,438 tonnes in May from 194,923 in April and against 172,350 in May last year.
Malaysia's palm kernel oil production rose 5.29 percent to 95,931 tonnes in May from 91,114 in April and against 85,847 in May 1996.
